title: Travel: John Lennon – New York City to London | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono returned to London from New York City on 14 July 1971.

They had arrived in the USA on 1 June, and while there took part in a number of endeavours: meetings with artists and political activists, performing with Frank Zappa and the Mothers of Invention, and attending custody hearings for Ono’s daughter Kyoko.

They returned to London to promote the reissue of Ono’s book Grapefruit, and to continue work on a film, which had the working title Your Show.
